name: B10-0255/2026 (PPE) – Situation of women and girls in Afghanistan following the Taliban’s adoption of the Criminal Procedure Code for Courts
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation of women and girls in Afghanistan following the Taliban’s adoption of the Criminal Procedure Code for Courts
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns a new Taliban code that it says legalises domestic violence, punishes women who seek protection, and allows flogging and the death penalty without fair trials. The Parliament asks the Taliban to withdraw the code. It also asks European Union countries to keep refusing to recognise the Taliban, to freeze the assets of Taliban leaders and ban their travel, and to give more support to Afghan women activists, lawyers and journalists. The text is a statement of position, not a law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament is asking the Taliban and European Union governments to act.
- **Who it affects:** Taliban leaders, European Union governments, and Afghan women and girls.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to European Union institutions, member states, the United Nations and the Taliban authorities.
